description: Hammer of the Gathering Storm Level 60 Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Ivory Scarabs and 5 Bronze Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest. Requirements: - Qiraji Spiked Hilt - Amber Idol x 2 - Bronze Scarab x 5 - Ivory Scarab x 5 - Cenarion Circle:
